note: A12.4. The divergent twin of xcut-queue-msgtype-go (same server/ + client/ NATS shape, no go.mod), so the MISMATCH case is a graded, diffable row in results.jsonl and not only a bench/message-contracts/check.sh assertion. The pair still links on the literal topic 'shipments' (QUEUE_FLOWS is topic-exact and ignores payload types, by design), and each side carries its OWN MESSAGE_TYPE: ShipmentCreated on the producer, ShipmentDispatched on the consumer. `message_contracts` turns exactly this pair into status=mismatch confidence=strong. Baseline 2026-09-17 at HEAD fdc80db (installed wheel, A12.1 already landed): nodes 2/2, QUEUE_FLOWS 1/1, cells 4/4 — the packet spec's '0.00 before A12.1' predates A12.1 landing in wave 10, so there was no 0.00 left to record; sensitivity was proved instead on a scratch copy whose consumer unmarshals pb.ShipmentCreated: both consumer rows (`type`, `raw`) miss and MESSAGE_TYPE reads 2/4. The `"type":"..."` rows pin the NORMALISED simple name with its closing quote, so a longer name that merely starts with it cannot pass. No `cells` field: a mechanism-depth probe, like its twin, not a matrix cell.
